summary: The change aligns reset election with the selected subscription cohort and adds focused coverage; no actionable defects were found.

evidence: account-routing.ts now derives the selected pool and computes reset-election exhaustion only across that pool.
routing-serial.ts uses the same selected pool for admission while preserving full-pool slot identities.
The added test covers one selected blocked account alongside a healthy unselected account and verifies reset election succeeds.
